critical_predictor_mapping:
  mapping_id: CRITICAL-PREDICTOR-MAPPING-01
  source: FROZEN_PART_A_TRAIN_RAW_FEATURE_SHAP_IMPORTANCE
  rule: PHASE7_TIER_1_FIRST_80_PERCENT_CUMULATIVE_ABS_SHAP
  critical_tiers: [TIER_1]
  current_monitoring_results_may_change_mapping: false

metric_roles:
  dq_missing_rate_absolute_change: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  dq_unseen_category_rate: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  feature_psi: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  score_psi: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  risk_positive_rate_absolute_change: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  roc_auc: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  performance_ks: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER

  recall_default_capture: DIRECT_ALERT_DRIVER
  pr_auc_average_precision: SUPPORTING_CORROBORATION
  brier_score: SUPPORTING_CORROBORATION
  log_loss: SUPPORTING_CORROBORATION
  specificity: SUPPORTING_CORROBORATION
  precision: SUPPORTING_CORROBORATION
  gini: DERIVED_ONLY
  false_negative_rate: DERIVED_ONLY
  p_values: NON_ALERTING
  segment_metrics: CONTEXT_ONLY_V1

feature_alert_mapping:
  WARNING:
    any_materiality: WARNING
  CRITICAL:
    critical_predictor: CRITICAL
    noncritical_predictor: WARNING
  upstream_metric_severity_rewrite_permitted: false

performance_reference_control_policy:
  policy_id: PERFORMANCE-ALERT-POLICY-01
  source_population: DEV-VAL-PHYSICAL-01
  iterations: 1000
  seed: 42
  resampling: STRATIFIED_WITH_REPLACEMENT_PRESERVE_CLASS_COUNTS
  warning_control_quantiles: [0.025, 0.975]
  critical_control_quantiles: [0.005, 0.995]
  warning_material_standard_deviations: 1.0
  critical_material_standard_deviations: 2.0
  both_material_and_control_breach_required: true
  p_value_only_alert_permitted: false
  metrics: [roc_auc, performance_ks, observed_expected_ratio, recall_default_capture]
  adverse_direction:
    roc_auc: LOWER_ONLY
    performance_ks: LOWER_ONLY
    recall_default_capture: LOWER_ONLY
    observed_expected_ratio: TWO_SIDED
  two_sided_center:
    observed_expected_ratio: REFERENCE_DISTRIBUTION

authorization:
  hard_contract_or_grain_failure: BLOCKED_HARD_GATE
  source_non_authoritative_with_valid_contract: BLOCKED_SOURCE_GOVERNANCE
  otherwise: AUTHORIZED

evidence_scope:
  outcomes_unavailable: LABEL_FREE_ONLY
  mature_eligible_synthetic_outcomes: FULL_OUTCOME_ELIGIBLE

overall_health:

  any_primary_component_critical: CRITICAL
  no_critical_any_primary_component_warning: WARNING
  all_required_components_normal_and_complete: NORMAL
  all_available_normal_but_required_evidence_missing: NOT_ASSESSABLE
  segment_component_role: CONTEXT_ONLY_NOT_REQUIRED_V1

alert_lifecycle:
  statuses: [OPEN, ACKNOWLEDGED, RESOLVED]
  initial_status: OPEN

persistence:
  warning_consecutive_comparable_runs_for_escalation: 2
  critical_immediate: true
  recovery_consecutive_comparable_normal_runs: 1
  current_scenario_calendar_persistence_claimed: false
  current_scenario_status: NOT_ASSESSABLE_NO_COMPARABLE_LONGITUDINAL_HISTORY

controlled_deferred:
